changelog:
Initial release: Establishes core rules to prevent common AI writing patterns in all generated text.

- Lists specific vocabulary to replace, flag, or watch for high density to avoid AI linguistic tells.
- Details structural patterns commonly found in AI writing, with clear "do/don't" examples for each.
- Covers conversational and formatting artifacts (e.g., sycophantic openers, formulaic conclusions) to eliminate.
- Designed as proactive writing rules, not as a detection or rewriting tool for existing text.
- Applies across all outputs and contexts, regardless of model or language.
summary: Rules to avoid identifiable AI writing patterns. Apply to all text output regardless of model or context.
